title: Principal LLM binding
description: One role binding of a principal's LLM account (ADR 0041 / 0045): catalog or private endpoint profile, optional model override, credential status, effective source and private lifecycle. Optional voice and language for speech roles (ADR 0043). Never a secret. profile_id is always present (for a private bind it is the endpoint's synthetic profile id).

voice.description: Provider voice id when the binding is for tts.

language.description: BCP 47 language when the binding is for tts or stt.

account_status.description: Whether the principal has an usable credential for this provider. Never a ref id the client can resolve to a secret. For self_hosted without a cred_ref, status is active.

source.description: Effective binding source for this role in the caller's current tenant (ADR 0045).

lifecycle.description: Lifecycle of the private endpoint when source is tenant_pin or principal_private.
